title: Murine CD8 T Cell Restimulation In Vitro
author: Kristin Anderson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.spqedmw

steps.title: Harvest T Cells
steps.instruction: Obtain spleens and record donor mouse information (background, number of spleens, gender, date of birth).

substeps.instruction: Smash spleens through a 40um filter to harvest T cells.
Rinse with 10-20 mL of T cell media and transfer to a 15 or 50 mL tube.
Centrifuge at 369 xg for 4-5 min at 4C.

steps.title: Perform ACK Lysis
steps.instruction: Perform ACK lysis and quench the reaction.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 ml of ACK lysis buffer per spleen and incubate for 2 min at room temperature.
Quench lysis by adding T cell media (equal to or greater than the ACK volume).

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Irradiation
steps.instruction: Wash and aliquot cells for irradiation.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 369 xg for 4-5 min at 4C.
Resuspend in T cell media.
Split cells into separate 15 mL tubes (1 tube per peptide condition), aliquoting 1ml of cells per tube.

steps.title: Irradiate and Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Irradiate cells and remove irradiation residues.

substeps.instruction: Irradiate at 3500 rad (35 Gy).
Immediately rinse cells by filling the tube with 10-20 mL of T cell media.
Centrifuge at 369 xg for 4-5 min at 4C.
Resuspend in 1-2 mL T cell media (volume depends on number of spleens/cells).

steps.title: Pulse Cells with Peptide
steps.instruction: Pulse the cells with the appropriate amount of peptide.

substeps.instruction: Add peptide to each tube (e.g., 1ug of peptide for 1-5 spleens).
Mix well and incubate at 37C for 60 to 90 minutes (longer if necessary).
Wash out excess peptide by rinsing with 10-12 mL T cell media.
Rinse a second time with 10-12 mL T cell media.

steps.title: Count and Prepare APCs and T Cells

substeps.instruction: Count the APCs.
Centrifuge T cells at 369 xg for 4-5 min at 4C.
Remove supernatant and resuspend T cells in 10 mL T cell media.
Count the T cells.

steps.title: Combine Cells and Plate
steps.instruction: Combine APCs and T cells for expansion in flasks.

substeps.instruction: Combine APCs and T cells at a 10:1 ratio (or up to 1:1 if APCs are limited).
Add T cell media to reach a final volume of 10 mL in T25 flasks.
Add 50 IU/mL IL-2.
Plate ideally 1-2e6 T cells and 10-20e6 APCs in an upright T25 flask (scale up proportionally for larger preparations).

steps.title: Maintain Culture and Adjust Media
steps.instruction: Monitor media color and maintain cell growth.

substeps.instruction: If media changes from orange to yellow, add a small volume of media (up to 10mL in a T25), ensuring cells are not over-diluted.
Add 50 IU/mL of IL-2.
